<style>
/* 02 / 49 · 现场扫码 */
body[data-current="2"] :is(.mast, .foot) {
  border-color: transparent;
}
#opening-works .b-body {
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 14px 2.8%;
}
#opening-works .b-intro {
  gap: 6px;
}
#opening-works .b-games {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 32px;
}
#opening-works .b-games article {
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 0;
  background: #255c88;
  border-radius: 12px;
}
#opening-works .b-screen {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  max-height: none;
  aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center;
}
#opening-works .b-game-info {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: 16px;
  padding: 12px 20px 12px 28px;
}
#opening-works .b-game-info h3 a {
  color: var(--fg);
}
#opening-works .b-game-info p {
  margin: 6px 0 0;
  color: #dce7ee;
  font-size: 26px;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
#opening-works .b-qr {
  width: 172px;
  height: 172px;
  border: 8px solid white;
  background: white;
}
#opening-works .b-qr img {
  image-rendering: pixelated;
}
#opening-works .b-closing,
#opening-works .b-prompt {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}
#opening-works .b-closing {
  gap: 24px;
}
#opening-works .b-prompt {
  gap: 22px;
  padding: 10px 24px;
  color: var(--accent);
  background: rgb(244 215 88 / 6%);
  border: 1px solid rgb(244 215 88 / 35%);
  border-radius: 8px;
}
#opening-works .b-prompt span {
  font: 650 20px/1.35 var(--sans);
  letter-spacing: .06em;
}
#opening-works .b-prompt strong {
  font: 760 38px/1.25 var(--serif);
}
#opening-works .b-hint {
  margin-left: auto;
  color: #b8cddc;
  font: 500 20px/1.4 var(--sans);
}
#opening-works .b-sea {
  flex: none;
  width: 200px;
  height: 72px;
  background-position: 78% 91%;
  background-size: 205% auto;
  background-repeat: no-repeat;
  opacity: .66;
  mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 74% 76% at 53% 54%, black 40%, transparent 84%);
  pointer-events: none;
}
@media screen and (max-width: 768px) and (orientation: portrait) {
  #opening-works .b-body { padding: 24px 5px; gap: 18px; }
  #opening-works .b-games { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 16px; }
  #opening-works .b-game-info { padding: 10px 12px; gap: 10px; }
  #opening-works .b-game-info h3 { font-size: clamp(21px, 5vw, 30px); }
  #opening-works .b-game-info p { font-size: 15px; }
  #opening-works .b-qr {
    width: clamp(92px, 23vw, 132px);
    height: clamp(92px, 23vw, 132px);
    border-width: 5px;
  }
  #opening-works .b-closing { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 12px; }
  #opening-works .b-prompt {
    width: 100%;
    align-items: flex-start;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
  }
  #opening-works .b-prompt span, #opening-works .b-hint { font-size: 13px; }
  #opening-works .b-prompt strong { font-size: clamp(21px, 5.5vw, 30px); }
  #opening-works .b-sea { width: 100px; height: 38px; }
}
</style>

<!-- 替换第 2 页原有的 rd-sheet 容器 -->
